annotations.title: Estimate the price to make public PDFs accessible

description: For one to five links to PDFs on public websites, counts pages by type and returns a price estimate from CyberNative AI LLC's published Terms for two options: an accessible web page made from the PDF (USD 6 per page with tables or scanned pages, USD 4 per other page), and, where the file qualifies, the same PDF with tags added (USD 4 per page, minimum USD 100 per order). Lists files and pages that are not converted, such as fillable forms, maps and drawings, with the reason. The estimate is not binding and nothing is ordered by calling this tool; the price is confirmed by email before any work. Use when the user asks what it would cost to have these PDFs made accessible.

detail.description: When true, adds the page-by-page count for each file.

urls.description: One to five links to PDFs on public websites: http or https, at most 2,048 characters each.
